body.objective: Add a typed fail-closed calculus for distribution kernels, causal support classes and wavefront relations. Finite exact matrices are now adoptable, but the causal and quantum work still expresses past/future compactness, bidistribution domains, kernel composition and Hadamard compatibility in project-specific prose and Python. The first consumers are sf:program/work/classical-bikernel-homotopy-extension-for-q26 and sf:program/work/quantum-berger-retained-bv-hadamard-restriction. Without this layer, Conflux must remain disabled on the most important Lorentzian structures because it cannot distinguish a matrix identity from a well-defined continuous kernel identity.
body.stop_condition: Define typed manifolds/charts or declared model spacetime identifiers, test-function and distribution spaces, compact/past-compact/future-compact/spacelike-compact/time-slice support classes, kernel source/target variables, transpose/adjoint, real structure and graded signs. Represent finite unions of exact conic wavefront relations and implement the standard fail-closed product, pullback, pushforward and kernel-composition transversality tests, together with causal-relation composition and propagation metadata. Provide typed advanced, retarded, causal, Hadamard and Feynman kernel roles; verify Green identities, chain-homotopy identities and Ward/intertwining relations only when both algebraic and support/wavefront preconditions pass. Demonstrate on the scalar wave operator and one finite-mode product-spacetime kernel; then import the q26 remainder and either certify its support category and legal correction compositions or return the exact undefined operation. Emit a canonical support/wavefront relation IR for Conflux, whose discovery rules may compare or compose only proved relations and must preserve UNDECIDED.
body.forbid: no sampled Fourier support called a wavefront-set proof; no smooth finite matrix kernel automatically treated as a spacetime distribution; no product or pullback formed when Hörmander transversality is undecided; no retarded label inferred from a sign convention alone; no positivity inferred from Hadamard singular structure; no physics-specific q26 or Berger kernel in lib/math; no Conflux rewrite permitted to erase support, topology, domain or wavefront annotations
notes: Priority 2 for Lorentzian adoption, but implement as a narrow typed calculus before attempting a general distribution library.
Exact rational polyhedral cones and named canonical relations are a useful first representation; unsupported smooth conic geometry must return UNDECIDED.
This request establishes well-definedness and transport conditions, not construction of a physical quantum state.
